steps.content: Hey, wake up.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: ...It's only been 10 minutes this time. You kept the grasp even if it was so painful. I underestimated you.
She wipes away the sweat on your forehead with her sleeve.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: So what's the conclusion?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: It's the same thing I've seen. It's Mania.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I was wrong. It's not something from the past or a future revelation. It is happening, the mental contamination field has enveloped the whole Drifter Camp, but there won't be any warning of it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=30>The anti-Mania monitoring system cannot capture it because there's no Mania contamination leaking from it. It directly captures a person's consciousness, consumes their spirit from within, and drains everything out of them before they turn into a Corruptor.</size>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That "thing" is different from all the Mania monsters. It's deliberately hiding itself. If it hadn't resonated and caused changes to 004, I'm afraid it could have dragged everyone into the abyss without anyone realizing it.
A contamination source that knows how to hide itself... This is too dangerous. Is it capable of this itself, or is someone guiding it?
Is it... them?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: ...Is this contamination source you mention still in Drifter Camp?
You can't answer and feel anxious about it. This concerns the safety of tens of thousands of people in Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Right, we could ask Furian where she had contact...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: She's no longer with us.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: It's not your fault. She has been holding on for too long. Everyone in Drifter Camp is trying very hard to stay alive, but staying alive is not an easy thing to do in the first place.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Do you want to ask her something? Sorry, I don't have Oak Casket's power, so I can't help you ask her questions.
She gently covers the eyes of the deceased with her hand, closing her weary eyes.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: You have no family... so let me send you off. Hopefully, the next time we meet, you will be smiling.
The girl stands up and blows her suona...
When the song ends, you are silent for a long time.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: What, moved to tears?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: You've never heard anything like this, have you? My suona is the best instrument in the world. It plays happiness and sorrow. Why are you acting so surprised about it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm just surprised you didn't ask for money this time.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Haha! There's no hurry, and this is another form of service. Gives me a good name.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: One day, all the people who have parted will see each other again, and by then... everyone will still remember my suona and me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You really love Drifter Camp, and it's why you've been showing me around.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you want me to see? And what would you like me to do?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: ...I don't know. You're the first big name who's come here, and you're the first... who would listen to us.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: I don't know if doing so will change anything.
She pauses, pats the dust on her butt and jumps up, and the witty look returns to her face.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: All right. I'll take her to Oak Casket now. What do you want to do?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Come down with me and ask questions? Or do you want to continue chasing the big monster yourself?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Aren't you going to stay with me?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: I don't have to anymore.
She grins.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: I believe you.
Believe? What does she believe?

Just as you are about to ask, you hear a "bang." Dudu takes a blow to the back of her head, and there is something strange about the attack. She instantly loses focus and falls forward, and a person wearing grayish-yellow catches her from behind.
Before you can see what the attackers look like, several guns are pointed at you. A couple of execs follow closely and break into the room.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I knew it was you as soon as I heard the suona, cutie.
The lead attacker and executive officer picks up the unconscious girl and looks around, muttering to himself with some smugness in his voice.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Good, the evidence is all there.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Notify the headquarters. Drifter Camp is confirmed to be harboring evil forces. It's time to work, and tell them to bring the big guns.
He hangs up and looks at you, suddenly showing a huge grin.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Want to come with me? We could use a witness.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Rustfire's little brat, or... an intruder?
